name: The Elementalists
source:
A college student enrolled at an exclusive university finds themselves being targeted by a mysterious enemy while learning that they may be one of the most powerful Magick wielders on the planet.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Category:The_Elementalists]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
一名就讀於頂尖大學的學生發現，自己成了某個神秘敵人的目標。與此同時，這名學生也逐漸得知，自己或許是這顆星球上最強大的魔法使用者之一。

[摘自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Category:The_Elementalists]Choices維基[/url]]
